list.name: run_ids
list.label: Rodadas (run_id) a comparar
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM saga_auditoria ORDER BY run_id DESC

options.content: Selecione duas ou mais rodadas em **Rodadas (run_id) a comparar** para ver, lado a lado, as mesmas nove métricas de `saga-metricas-experimento.json` calculadas por rodada. A tabela abaixo resume tudo; os gráficos de barras logo depois comparam cada métrica individualmente entre as rodadas escolhidas.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS primeira_falha,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falhas,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'COMPENSACAO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compensacoes
  FROM saga_auditoria
  WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
),
metricas AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(concluida) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Taxa de sucesso (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio) FILTER (WHERE concluida = 1 AND fim IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "Tempo médio conclusão (ms)",
    ROUND(AVG(fim - primeira_falha) FILTER (WHERE falhas > 0 AND fim IS NOT NULL AND primeira_falha IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "Tempo médio recuperação (ms)",
    ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio) FILTER (WHERE fim IS NOT NULL AND inicio IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "Tempo até consistência (ms)",
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
         THEN ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 AND concluida = 1 AND compensacoes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2)
         ELSE 0 END AS "Recuperadas sem compensação (%)",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inicio IS NOT NULL) AS total_sagas,
    MIN(inicio) FILTER (WHERE inicio IS NOT NULL) AS menor_inicio,
    MAX(fim) FILTER (WHERE fim IS NOT NULL) AS maior_fim
  FROM sagas
  GROUP BY run_id
),
eventos AS (
  SELECT run_id,
    COUNT(*) AS "Volume de eventos",
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'COMPENSACAO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Compensações",
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'RETRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Retries"
  FROM saga_auditoria
  WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT
  m.run_id AS "Run",
  m."Taxa de sucesso (%)",
  m."Tempo médio conclusão (ms)",
  m."Tempo médio recuperação (ms)",
  m."Recuperadas sem compensação (%)",
  CASE WHEN m.maior_fim > m.menor_inicio
       THEN ROUND(m.total_sagas / ((m.maior_fim - m.menor_inicio) / 1000.0), 2)
       ELSE 0 END AS "Throughput (ops)",
  e."Compensações",
  e."Retries",
  e."Volume de eventos",
  m."Tempo até consistência (ms)"
FROM metricas m
JOIN eventos e ON e.run_id = m.run_id
ORDER BY m.run_id;

panels.title: Taxa de sucesso das sagas por rodada

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida
  FROM saga_auditoria
  WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
)
SELECT run_id, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(concluida) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "Taxa de sucesso"
FROM sagas GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id;

panels.title: Tempo médio de conclusão por rodada

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
)
SELECT run_id, ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio), 2) AS "Tempo médio de conclusão"
FROM sagas WHERE concluida = 1 AND fim IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id;

panels.title: Tempo médio de recuperação após falhas por rodada

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS primeira_falha,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falhas
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
)
SELECT run_id, ROUND(AVG(fim - primeira_falha), 2) AS "Tempo médio de recuperação"
FROM sagas WHERE falhas > 0 AND fim IS NOT NULL AND primeira_falha IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'FALHA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falhas,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acao = 'COMPENSACAO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compensacoes
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
),
agregado AS (
  SELECT run_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS com_falha,
    SUM(CASE WHEN falhas > 0 AND concluida = 1 AND compensacoes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recuperadas_sem_compensacao
  FROM sagas GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT run_id, CASE WHEN com_falha > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * recuperadas_sem_compensacao / com_falha, 2) ELSE 0 END AS "% recuperadas sem compensação"
FROM agregado ORDER BY run_id;

WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
),
agregado AS (
  SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS total, MIN(inicio) AS menor_inicio, MAX(fim) AS maior_fim
  FROM sagas WHERE inicio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT run_id, CASE WHEN maior_fim > menor_inicio
            THEN ROUND(total / ((maior_fim - menor_inicio) / 1000.0), 2)
            ELSE 0 END AS "Throughput"
FROM agregado ORDER BY run_id;

panels.title: Tempo até consistência eventual por rodada

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_INICIADA' THEN timestamp_millis END) AS inicio,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao IN ('SAGA_CONCLUIDA','SAGA_COMPENSADA','SAGA_ABORTADA','SAGA_REJEITADA') THEN timestamp_millis END) AS fim
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
)
SELECT run_id, ROUND(AVG(fim - inicio), 2) AS "Tempo até consistência eventual"
FROM sagas WHERE fim IS NOT NULL AND inicio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id;

panels.title: Volume total de eventos por rodada

targets.rawSql:
WITH sagas AS (
  SELECT run_id, solicitacao_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_CONCLUIDA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concluida,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_COMPENSADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compensada,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_ABORTADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abortada,
    MAX(CASE WHEN acao = 'SAGA_REJEITADA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejeitada
  FROM saga_auditoria WHERE run_id IN (${run_ids:sqlstring}) GROUP BY run_id, solicitacao_id
)
SELECT run_id,
  SUM(concluida)::int AS "Concluída",
  SUM(compensada)::int AS "Compensada",
  SUM(abortada)::int AS "Abortada",
  SUM(rejeitada)::int AS "Rejeitada",
  SUM(CASE WHEN concluida = 0 AND compensada = 0 AND abortada = 0 AND rejeitada = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS "Em andamento"
FROM sagas GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY run_id;
